narrative.overview: Vivarium looks like a well-kept notebook used in the evening beside the enclosures: warm near-black paper, serif headings set like journal entries, and a single leaf-green ink reserved for what the keeper can act on. It is dark-only on purpose.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, warm-tinted neutrals (never pure black or blue-grey).
Playfair Display for headings and names; DM Sans for everything a keeper reads quickly.
One accent (leaf green) for actions and "on schedule"; amber and red only for urgency.
Flat tonal layering: surfaces step up in lightness instead of casting shadows.
Rounded, soft-cornered containers (12px) and pill chips.

rules.name: The Earned Colour Rule
rules.body: Amber and red appear only when an animal or task needs something.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Leaf green marks what can be tapped or what is going well. If an element is neither, it is grey.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Names Rule
rules.body: Playfair is for names and headings only. Data, counts, buttons and labels are DM Sans.

rules.name: The Lamp-Off Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Nothing glows.

dos: Do keep every surface warm: Night Soil, Bark and Moss Stone, never #000 or a blue-grey.
Do use status colour only for status, and pair it with words.
Do set animal names and headings in Playfair Display and everything else in DM Sans.
Do keep form controls at 16px on phones; pinch-zoom stays enabled.
Do show loading, failed and empty as three different states.
donts: Don't add a light theme or bright surfaces.
Don't use gradients, glows or decorative shadows on cards.
Don't introduce a second accent hue for actions.
